tools.description: Yacht models (Lagoon 42, Bali 4.2, Oceanis 46.1…) that have discounted weeks now: boats and weeks, destinations, lowest whole-boat and per-berth price, biggest and median discount, cabins, berths, build years and the model page. tools.name: get_yacht_model
tools.description: One yacht model in depth: its numbers across all discounted weeks, where it is available and from what price, the ten cheapest weeks, the five biggest discounts and similar models. Pass the model name (e.g. Lagoon 42) or its page URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_boat, get_route, request_availability, create_deal_alert, search_guides, get_yacht_model · Private data: search_guides · Public sink: prices_by_month, request_availability, create_deal_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_boat, get_route, request_availability, create_deal_alert, search_guides, get_yacht_model · Private data: search_guides · Public sink: prices_by_month, request_availability, create_deal_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_routes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
